beschikking.title: Beschikking
beschikking.description: Formal decision (Awb besluit) with full lifecycle: ontwerp -> akkoord-mandaat -> ondertekend -> verzonden -> ontvangen-bevestiging -> gearchiveerd. Immutable once ondertekend. State transitions are guarded by mandaat-verificatie (akkoord) and TSP-handtekening (onderteken) and logged via stateMachineLog.

zaakId.title: Case ID
zaakId.description: Back-reference to the procest case this beschikking belongs to

ontwerpVersie.title: Draft Version
ontwerpVersie.description: Auto-increment as the draft is re-rendered or field-edited

bekendmakingDatum.title: Announcement Date
bekendmakingDatum.description: Date the beschikking becomes legally effective (Awb 3:41)

bezwaarTermijnEindDatum.title: Objection Period End Date
bezwaarTermijnEindDatum.description: End of the 6-week bezwaartermijn (Awb 6:7), computed on verzending

herinneringDatum.title: Reminder Date
herinneringDatum.description: Reminder date, one week before bezwaarTermijnEindDatum

legesbedrag.title: Levy Amount
legesbedrag.description: Leges amount associated with the decision

format.title: Format
format.description: File format of the rendered document, e.g. pdf-a3

bestandId.title: File ID
bestandId.description: Nextcloud file id of the rendered PDF

checksumSha256.title: SHA-256 Checksum
checksumSha256.description: SHA-256 hash of the rendered file for integrity verification

paginas.title: Page Count
paginas.description: Number of pages in the rendered document

geadresseerde.title: Addressee
geadresseerde.description: Addressee (a citizen or a business). BSN/OIN are special-category identifiers and are masked when logged.

type.title: Addressee Type
type.description: Whether the addressee is a citizen (burger) or a business (bedrijf)

bsn.title: BSN
bsn.description: Burger identifier (special category, masked in logs)

berichtenboxBevestigd.title: Message Box Confirmed
berichtenboxBevestigd.description: Whether the addressee's berichtenbox address has been confirmed

soort.title: Decision Sort
soort.description: Type of the decision, e.g. toekenning or afwijzing

omvang.title: Scope
omvang.description: Extent or scope of the decision, e.g. number of hours per week

ingangsdatum.title: Start Date
ingangsdatum.description: Date from which the decision takes effect

einddatum.title: End Date
einddatum.description: Date on which the decision expires

mandaatGegeven.title: Mandate Granted
mandaatGegeven.description: Point-in-time mandaat record captured at the akkoord step (ADR design D3)

mandaatregelingId.title: Mandate Regulation ID
mandaatregelingId.description: Reference to the mandaatRegeling in effect at the time of approval

akkoordDatum.title: Approval Date
akkoordDatum.description: Timestamp at which the mandate approval was recorded

handtekening.title: Signature
handtekening.description: eIDAS-qualified electronic signature metadata; durably retained for future validation

tspProvider.title: TSP Provider
tspProvider.description: Name of the Trust Service Provider that issued the signature

tspProviderEidasId.title: TSP Provider eIDAS ID
tspProviderEidasId.description: eIDAS identifier of the TSP provider

ondertekenaar.title: Signatory
ondertekenaar.description: Nextcloud UID of the person who signed the document

ondertekeningTijdstip.title: Signing Timestamp
ondertekeningTijdstip.description: Date and time at which the document was signed

certificaatSerienummer.title: Certificate Serial Number
certificaatSerienummer.description: Serial number of the signing certificate

validatieRapportId.title: Validation Report ID
validatieRapportId.description: Reference to the signature validation report

kanaal.title: Dispatch Channel
kanaal.description: Channel used for dispatch, e.g. berichtenbox-mijnoverheid

verzondenOp.title: Sent On
verzondenOp.description: Timestamp at which the beschikking was sent

verzondenDoor.title: Sent By
verzondenDoor.description: Actor who sent the beschikking (user id or 'systeem')

ontvangstBevestigingOp.title: Receipt Confirmation On
ontvangstBevestigingOp.description: Timestamp at which receipt was confirmed

leesBevestigingOp.title: Read Confirmation On
leesBevestigingOp.description: Timestamp at which the message was read by the recipient

archief.title: Archive
archief.description: Archival record (TMLO/MDTO) populated when the beschikking is archived via the OpenRegister archival pipeline

gearchiveerdOp.title: Archived On
gearchiveerdOp.description: Timestamp at which the beschikking was archived

archiefId.title: Archive ID
archiefId.description: Identifier assigned by the archival system

vernietigingsdatum.title: Destruction Date
vernietigingsdatum.description: Date on which the archived record is scheduled for destruction

stateMachineLog.title: State Machine Log
stateMachineLog.description: Immutable record of a single beschikking state transition, including actor, trigger, and supporting evidence (mandaat reference or TSP rapport).

beschikkingId.title: Decision ID
beschikkingId.description: The beschikking this transition belongs to

tijdstip.title: Timestamp
tijdstip.description: Date and time of the state transition

actorType.title: Actor Type
actorType.description: Whether the actor is a medewerker or the system

trigger.title: Trigger
trigger.description: Whether the transition was initiated manually or automatically

bewijsMateriaal.title: Evidence Material
bewijsMateriaal.description: Supporting evidence for this transition, such as a mandate or signature report

soort.title: Evidence Type
soort.description: Type of evidence, e.g. mandaat or tsp-rapport

bezwaarTrigger.title: Bezwaar Trigger
bezwaarTrigger.description: Scheduling record created when a beschikking is verzonden. Drives the daily BezwaarTermijnJob: when the bezwaartermijn lapses without a bezwaarschrift, archival is triggered.

beschikkingId.title: Decision ID
beschikkingId.description: The beschikking this trigger belongs to

bekendmakingDatum.title: Announcement Date
bekendmakingDatum.description: Date the beschikking was publicly announced

herinneringDatum.title: Reminder Date
herinneringDatum.description: Reminder date, one week before the bezwaarTermijnEindDatum

bezwaarOntvangen.title: Objection Received
bezwaarOntvangen.description: Whether a bezwaarschrift has been received

archiefTriggerActief.title: Archive Trigger Active
archiefTriggerActief.description: Whether the archival trigger is still active

archiefDatum.title: Archive Date
archiefDatum.description: Date on which archival becomes due

mandaatRegeling.title: Mandaatregeling
mandaatRegeling.description: Defines which approval levels (niveau) may sign which decision types up to which bedrag (Awb 10:3-10:12). Point-in-time: the regeling-id + version is captured on the beschikking at akkoord.

naam.title: Name
naam.description: Human-readable name of the mandate regulation

verleendDoor.title: Granted By
verleendDoor.description: Body that granted the mandate, e.g. college-bw

verleendDatum.title: Grant Date
verleendDatum.description: Date on which the mandate was granted

intrekkingsDatum.title: Revocation Date
intrekkingsDatum.description: Date on which the mandate was revoked, if applicable

ondermandaatToegestaan.title: Sub-mandate Permitted
ondermandaatToegestaan.description: Whether delegation to a lower level is permitted

tot_bedrag.title: Up To Amount
tot_bedrag.description: Upper bedrag limit; null means unlimited

zaaktypes.title: Case Types
zaaktypes.description: Case types for which this authorization level applies

beschikkingTypes.title: Decision Types
beschikkingTypes.description: Decision types for which this authorization level applies

De aanvrager heeft voldaan aan de eisen van de Omgevingswet.
